ui_bugs.issue: pb-specialist-card is NEVER rendered in DOM for existing specialists even though /api/benefits/specialist-summary returns 200 with 3 messages. Rail only shows spec-today-summary + spec-progress-card. Root cause: `SpecialistDashboard.jsx:192` uses `xosLayout || DEFAULT`. Specialists that already have a saved xosLayout in the DB do not have `pb_benefits` in their layout list, so the widget is filtered out. The DEFAULT includes pb_benefits, but only new users hit that path. Fix: (a) always inject `pb_benefits` if missing from stored layout, or (b) migrate existing xosLayout docs to include pb_benefits.

Logged-in client visiting /marketplace is redirected by ServiceGate (serviceId='specialisti') to the marketing landing page — PublicMarketplace is never mounted for this client in the demo env, so pb-mkt-strip cannot be verified via UI. Backend endpoint /api/benefits/marketplace-flags returns 4 flags correctly (verified). This is a pre-existing ServiceGate behavior, NOT a PB-002 defect; noted for main agent.

action_items: Ensure existing specialists get pb_benefits widget: on SpecialistDashboard render (or in a migration), merge 'pb_benefits' into the stored xosLayout if absent, so pb-specialist-card renders for all specialists (not just new ones falling through to DEFAULT).

Optional (out of scope for PB-002): investigate why ServiceGate('specialisti') redirects logged-in client away from /marketplace — this prevents pb-mkt-strip from being exercised in UI (backend works fine).
Pre-existing (iteration_167): mentor pb_ prefix drift — 1 pre-existing failure in test_pb001_prop_benefits.py::test_mentor_returns_pb_action still fails (23/24). Unrelated to PB-002.
critical_code_review_comments: SpecialistDashboard.jsx:192 — using stored xosLayout without ensuring newly added widgets are included is fragile. Every time a new widget is added to the rail (pb_benefits here), existing users won't see it. Recommend: `const order = mergeWidgetLists(xosLayout, DEFAULT)` that guarantees any DEFAULT widget missing from stored layout is appended.

propbenefits/summaries.py::client_pulse computes saved_value by summing wallet.used[].value_estimate + waived*45 — assumes lead_fee_waived=True flag is set on requests (undocumented). Verified working for demo client.
propbenefits/community_deals.py::support_deal — uses $addToSet (idempotent). Good. But no rate limiting — a user could theoretically POST support to all 12 deals in a burst. Non-issue for MVP.
routes/prop_benefits.py::my_context_banner returns 400 for unknown surface — correctly rejected in test.

rca of the issue: Specialist card missing: SpecialistDashboard.jsx computes `const order = xosLayout || DEFAULT;`. For existing specialists whose xosLayout doc was saved BEFORE pb_benefits was added to DEFAULT, `xosLayout` truthy → DEFAULT is skipped → pb_benefits ID never enters the render list → SpecialistBenefitsCard never mounted. Even though the API endpoint /api/benefits/specialist-summary works and returns 3 messages, the component is not in the tree. Fix: merge missing keys from DEFAULT into xosLayout on load, or run a one-time migration adding pb_benefits to all existing specialist xosLayout docs.
